watch: Run long commands with saved output and progress.
watch ci-run: Watch every CI run for one commit.
watch deploy: Run a deployment and watch its progress.
watch doctor: Run doctor and watch its progress.
watch fleet: Watch for changes across the fleet.
watch merge: Run a merge and report only its outcome.
watch preflight: Run the migration preflight and watch its progress.
watch pytest: Run tests and watch their progress.
watch qa-case: Run one QA case and watch its progress.
watch qa-plan: Run a QA plan and watch its progress.
watch tail: Follow a watcher's progress file until the run ends.
